notes: Animated 3D demos: tap the ⓘ on any exercise to watch a figure do the movement, with the working muscles lit up and three form tips. Drag to turn it around.
Starter programs: the app can now build a split from your goals, gym days and equipment. Find it in Train, or at the end of setup.
Skill trackers in Lifts: mile time, max pull-ups, vertical jump, plank hold and more, with personal bests.
Backups now include your progress photos, and you can back up in one tap right after a workout.
Reorder exercises mid-workout (⋯ menu), the Log button shows which set you're on, and Settings is grouped into sections.
